interpretationNotes: The THC page lists 29 governments with known interests and distinguishes three located in Texas; the Children’s Commission names those three. These are different association types.

The remaining 26 list entries are not therefore absent from Texas history or excluded from Texas interests. Conversely, a contact/interest listing alone does not document every proposed historical association.

The official list is a government consultation aid and may change. It is not a complete list of every Indigenous community, urban population, non-federally recognized organization or nation whose members live in Texas.

Names are recorded as printed by THC, including older or abbreviated labels. This pass does not independently reconcile every name with the latest Federal Register nomenclature or determine each government’s present legal status.
No legal advice, people contact, new recognition application, profile work count, canonical nation count or inferred modern border is produced.
